text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf corners me one day, a
serious
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I realize this is sudden, but would you
join me on
an errand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I fear I may not have the strength to go
alone...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What could have daunted Symboli
Rudolf so
badly? Curious, I decide to go
with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She leads me to a T-shirt shop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"My bicycle is two-tired"... "My
calendar's days
are numbered"...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. This store is truly dangerous.
Had I come
alone, I daresay I would be
clutching my sides at
this very moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, precisely. Despite their
unassuming
typeface, each one carries a
marvelous display of
wit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I discovered this shop in the course of
my endless search for new puns. I've
always wanted to browse
through it
properly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Dedication is the soul of wit. Never stop

practicing, and always be on the lookout
for new
material."
choice_data_list: ...You mean you found it while loo...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Or so it says in my copy of "Comedy for

Dummies," at any rate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's quite the enlightening read. I could
lend it to
you, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have but to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, to the point. Armed with one of
these
T-shirts, I fancy I could have the
entire academy
doubled over.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You raise a good point. Not
everybody will
appreciate such subtle
humor.
choice_data_list: Maybe that joke's a bit too highbrow.
Everyone's probably going to be su...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It may very well fall flat, and then what
would be
the point?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I'll hold off on debuting one
of these
shirts in public for now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, with that said...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like to purchase one, at least.
My
signature punwear, if you will.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you suppose you could help me pick
one out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enter the shop and spend a while
browsing
T-shirts together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Ahahaha! Oh, this is priceless!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Doing our best to keep straight faces,
we settle
on a favorite and leave with a
new shirt and a
fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would, wouldn't I? I can only imagine
the howls
of laughter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be long before the entire
academy was
plunged into chaos...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I'd be opening Pandora's box. Thank
you for
bringing me to my senses.
